checks.label: Freeze permanently surrendered
checks.detail: lsfNoFreeze is not set. The issuer retains the ability to freeze holders' lines, and can exercise it at any time without notice to the holder.

checks.label: Issuance not frozen now
checks.detail: lsfGlobalFreeze is clear. Lines are not under a global freeze at this ledger.

checks.label: Holding does not require issuer permission
checks.detail: lsfRequireAuth is clear. Any account may open a line without the issuer's permission.

checks.label: No single key controls the issuer
checks.detail: 2 signers must agree to reach the quorum of 25, derived from summed weights rather than a headcount.

checks.label: Supply concentration
checks.detail: Supply was not walked for this certificate, so no concentration finding is made. This is an abstention, not a pass.
